scientific_integrity: Analytic proof of a model-specific uniqueness threshold, an exact optimality condition, and a sharp compositional-amplification bound; numerical tests are supplementary, and no independent external validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Three uncoupled exponential capture curves with fixed positive plateau levels and ordered capture rates.
Ideal fixed-depth conditional read model, not actual recovery at exactly zero deployment time.
No kinetic coupling, sample inhibition, variable sequencing depth, field calibration or claim about general capture laws.
title: A sharp transient-composition law for three saturating ecological markers
